ceu: ✦ The trine between the Sun and Uranus

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Take a long bath and imagine the water carrying away the weight of the day.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, routine and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, money and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.
